defect: Accepted successors retained the short delivery lease while waiting for a committed handoff; ordinary queue cleanup could mark their outcome unknown before that handoff.
repair: Inside the workflow-event transaction, validated acceptance retains the successor lease until the earlier resident or successor admitted deadline. Status remains leased. Expired or non-leased rows are not revived. Exact event replay returns before this update.

tests.negative_evidence: Initial lease fixture run failed because pg-mem does not implement timestamp LEAST. Registered the PostgreSQL function semantics in the fixture; production SQL was unchanged.

limitations: In-memory SQL tests do not prove PostgreSQL concurrency or live reconnect behavior.
Native acceptance measurement persistence across immediate interruption needs review before production qualification.
Production route/admission wiring and packaged three-cycle live acceptance remain outstanding.
